in_sanskrit.name: Faiyaj
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Conqueror of gods
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Faiyaj एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Faiyaj is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'Vajra', which means 'thunderbolt'. In Hindu mythology, Indra, the god of rain and thunder, wielded a vajra, or thunderbolt. Faiyaj can be considered the name of a god or a warrior who conquers the gods with his power.
